description: This PHP script contains test cases that upload attachments to a TestLink server via XML-RPC API. It requires external utility and sample include files, and uses the IXR_Client class for XML-RPC communication. It defines test procedures for uploading image files as attachments to a specific test case.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: A class used for XML-RPC communication with the TestLink server.

methods.name: runTest
methods.description: Function to execute the XML-RPC call with provided client, method, arguments, and test number.
